project.purpose: Represent existing source-qualified discovery, admission, binding, and bounded read as independently consumable LEGO responsibilities; derive all source/installation facts from existing Skills MCP and Git, not another Skill registry.

nodes.label: SkillSourceDiscovery
nodes.responsibility: Discover candidate Agent Skills from configured source roots and construct source-scoped records without executing untrusted Skill content.
nodes.authority: Skills configured source and local package file facts only
inputs: Configured SkillSource roots, validation mode, project and workspace source context.
outputs: Candidate SkillRecord inventory, source health and diagnostics with exact instruction/package source identity.
behavioralContract: Missing, inaccessible, invalid or escaped source roots cannot masquerade as valid discovered records. Source scanning has no authority to execute or apply instructions.
A discovered record is not automatically trusted, visible, installed or invoked.
acceptance: Existing SkillCatalog.scan tests qualify stable identity, package source and inaccessible-source behavior under exact configured roots.
Real deployed source selection and current installation remain separate evidence.

nodes.label: SkillTrustEligibilityGate
nodes.responsibility: Qualify candidate Skill visibility by source trust, package scanning, eligibility, invocation mode and scoped user/audited admission without transferring execution authority.
nodes.authority: Skills discovery/visibility policy; cannot assign Agent or Tool action authority
inputs: Candidate SkillRecord inventory, audit/user-selection predicates, scanner findings, workspace/Agent context, declared eligibility requirements.
outputs: Explicit and implicit filtered visible Skill views or qualification rejection with reasons.
behavioralContract: Quarantined, untrusted or ineligible Skill cannot silently be promoted into implicit invocation. Advisory sanitation may remove textual instructions but cannot relax Tool execution authority.
Explicit choice is distinct from implicit discovery and must respect source policy.
acceptance: Existing negative scans/visibility tests fail closed on quarantined, blocked, or untrusted Skill records.
No scan PASS alone is an instruction-authority or domain-correctness claim.

nodes.label: ContextQualifiedSkillBinding
nodes.responsibility: Choose one canonical Skill identity by deterministic source precedence, explicit reference or qualified lexical match under one snapshot/context.
nodes.authority: Skills catalog selection only, not workload ownership or permission
inputs: Visible catalog, canonical SkillRef or friendly name, invocation mode, Agent/workspace context, optional expected snapshot revision.
outputs: Selected canonical SkillRecord and snapshot revision, or exact stale/not-visible/ambiguous admission result.
behavioralContract: A stale expected snapshot must fail closed; duplicate-friendly-name precedence uses declared deterministic ordering. A source candidate cannot impersonate the winner on the basis of name alone.
A selected reference is not proof that the client has consumed current Skill bytes.
acceptance: Existing catalog and MCP tests verify exact SkillRef resolution, stable snapshot and stale-snapshot rejection.
Installed Skill source and selected source match need separate current deployment evidence.

nodes.label: ExactBoundSkillResourceRead
nodes.responsibility: Read selected Skill resources only within the source-qualified package boundary, with digest and package revision checks and advisory projection.
inputs: Canonical selected SkillId, relative package resource path, expected instruction digest, package revision, expected snapshot, byte offset and limit.
outputs: Bounded read result with exact resource/raw/projection digests and content, or fail-closed stale/path/digest error.
behavioralContract: Absolute, traversal or escaped resource paths fail closed; instruction bytes and package revision must match declared fences, including a post-read revision check.
A sanitized advisory text result is not Tool or system instruction authority and does not certify behavioral correctness of the Skill.
acceptance: Existing MCP and catalog tests verify exact revision/digest/path bounding and advisory projection behavior.
LIVE Skills resolver and Git SKILL.md digests may differ; historical source proof is not deployed freshness.

edges.label: candidate source inventory before trust/eligibility qualification
canonical binding and snapshot context constrain exact read

gaps: Exact installed Skills MCP release is separate from the Git source plan. Agent uses observed skills_resolve/read tools; Git SKILL.md and discovered instruction digest differ on 2026-10-27 and require deployment qualification.
No source-only claim of complete external MCP/Gateway consumer closure or of Skill text authority; static Skills tests do not establish all dynamic plugin clients.
doNotOwn: untrusted Skill instructions as privileged code
